title: The distance from functions in BMO to BLO
summary: Let BMO and BLO denote the spaces of all locally integrable real-valued functions on $\mathbb{R}^n$ with bounded mean oscillation and bounded lower oscillation, respectively. It is well known that $$L^\infty(\mathbb{R}^n)\subsetneqq {\rm BLO}\subsetneqq {\rm BMO}.$$ In 1978, Garnett and Jones gave distance formulas of $f\in {\rm BMO}$ to $L^\infty(\mathbb{R}^n)$ and recently, Angrisani studied the distance of $f\in {\rm BLO}$ to $L^\infty(\mathbb{R}^n)$.
